author: austinbaustinb
content:
Testing a feeding team scheduler thing. Pretty much just the same thing megan has set up, but it allows for easier sub requests. There will be 'hey someone still needs this spot filled' reminders maybe a week out, then three days, then the morning of. That typa stuff.
I gotta figure out a way to have a good sign-in restriction so that only officers can edit the schedule and then anyone can do a sub request, but here's the bare bones of it. Automatically adjusts the dates and stations you can request a sub for to be only the ones you're assigned to.

Either way, makes it a lot simpler. Lots less false positives. It will ping people according to this and the sub list, and its easier to access.

author: austinbaustinb
